name: small-office
description: 本地单用户多 AI 员工桌面办公室

scripts.test:desktop-boundary: node --test desktop/client-boundary.test.cjs desktop/chat-presentation.test.cjs desktop/chat-refresh.test.cjs && electron desktop/preload-sandbox-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:desktop-client: npm run desktop:client:build && electron desktop/client-render-smoke.cjs && electron desktop/client-render-smoke.cjs --refresh-isolation
scripts.test:model-settings: npm run desktop:client:build && electron desktop/client-render-smoke.cjs --model-settings && node desktop/run-gateway-integration.cjs --model-settings
scripts.test:employee-model: npm run desktop:client:build && electron desktop/client-render-smoke.cjs --employee-model && node desktop/run-gateway-integration.cjs --model-settings
scripts.test:visualization: node --test desktop/visualization.test.cjs && npm run desktop:client:build && node desktop/run-gateway-integration.cjs --visualization
scripts.test:minimum: npm run test:desktop-boundary && npm run test:desktop-client
scripts.test:i18n: node client/scripts/check-i18n.cjs && node --test desktop/localization.test.cjs && npm run desktop:client:build && electron desktop/client-render-smoke.cjs --i18n
